title: Rabbi Zeira bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Keritot 27a: he reviewed his learning every thirty days before Rabbi Yochanan. But Hyman says the reading should be Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada, as in Berakhot 38b and Chullin 86b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Keritot 27a paragraph names Rabbi Zeira bar Ada reviewing his learning before an implicit addressee. Hyman explicitly supplies Rabbi Yochanan and proposes Chiyya bar Ada instead; these remain Hyman’s account and proposed correction.

The checked Keritot 27a paragraph names Rabbi Zeira bar Ada with an implicit addressee. Berakhot 38b names Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba reviewing before Rabbi Yochanan every thirty days; Chullin 86b also names Chiyya bar Abba in that account and Abba as his son. Hyman explicitly supplies Yochanan and says the name should read Chiyya bar Ada. His Ada form and corrective force remain attributed, without Hebrew or genealogy repair.
